## Plot Gradient Magnitudes as Image for each Grass Image

```{r}
library(readr)
mags <- read_csv("../output/angles_mags/DJI_0362.csv")
```


```{python}
# Save gradient magnitudes of Test Grass in image form

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 8))
plt.title('DJI_0362')
plt.imshow(mags$mag, cmap="gray")
plt.axis("on")
plt.show()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("../output/images/DJI_0362_mag.jpg", dpi=300)
```


```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

mags = pd.read_csv("../output/angles_mags/DJI_0362.csv")

# if mag is a flat array, reshape may be needed
img = mags["mag"].values

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 8))
plt.title("DJI_0362")

plt.imshow(img, cmap="gray")
plt.axis("on")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("../output/images/DJI_0362_mag.jpg", dpi=300)
plt.show()
```
